# Cornell University
> Cornell University is a private research university offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional education across more than 100 fields of study.

Cornell’s primary web presence spans university-wide information, admissions, academics, research, news, libraries, and student services, with campuses in Ithaca, New York City, and Doha.

## About Cornell
- [About Cornell](https://www.cornell.edu/about/): University overview, mission, campuses, leadership, and institutional priorities.
- [Cornell History](https://www.cornell.edu/about/timeline/): Historical timeline of Cornell’s founding, milestones, and development.
- [Maps & Directions](https://www.cornell.edu/about/maps/): Campus maps, directions, and visitor navigation resources.
- [Mission & Vision](https://www.cornell.edu/about/mission.cfm): Official statement of Cornell’s mission and institutional vision.
- [Core Values](https://www.cornell.edu/about/values.cfm): University values and principles guiding the Cornell community.
- [Locations](https://www.cornell.edu/about/locations/): Overview of Cornell’s campuses and major locations.
- [Ithaca](https://www.cornell.edu/about/locations/ithaca/): Information about Cornell’s Ithaca campus and surrounding community.
- [New York City](https://www.cornell.edu/about/locations/nyc/): Information about Cornell’s New York City presence and programs.

## Admissions
- [Admissions](https://www.cornell.edu/admissions/): Central admissions hub for undergraduate, graduate, and professional study.
- [How to Apply](https://admissions.cornell.edu/how-to-apply): Undergraduate application requirements, deadlines, and submission guidance.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://admissions.cornell.edu/): Undergraduate admissions overview, application process, and applicant resources.
- [Visit Cornell](https://admissions.cornell.edu/visit): Campus visit options, tours, and admissions events.
- [Tuition & Aid](https://finaid.cornell.edu/): Financial aid, scholarships, and cost of attendance information.
- [Graduate School Admissions](https://gradschool.cornell.edu/admissions/): Graduate admissions requirements, application steps, and deadlines.

## Academics
- [Academics](https://www.cornell.edu/academics/): Overview of Cornell’s academic programs, colleges, and educational opportunities.
- [Fields of Study](https://www.cornell.edu/academics/fields.cfm): Searchable list of undergraduate, graduate, and professional fields of study.
- [Undergraduate Education](https://www.cornell.edu/academics/undergraduate.cfm): Undergraduate academic opportunities, advising, and degree pathways.
- [Graduate Education](https://www.cornell.edu/academics/graduate-professional.cfm): Graduate and professional education overview across Cornell programs.
- [Continuing Education & Summer Sessions](https://sce.cornell.edu/): Continuing education, online learning, and summer session offerings.
- [Courses of Study](https://courses.cornell.edu/): Official catalog of courses, programs, and degree requirements.
- [University Registrar](https://registrar.cornell.edu/): Academic calendar, enrollment, registration, and transcript services.

## Colleges and Schools
- [Colleges & Schools](https://www.cornell.edu/academics/colleges-schools.cfm): Directory of Cornell’s undergraduate, graduate, and professional schools.
- [College of Agriculture and Life Sciences](https://cals.cornell.edu/): Academic programs, research, and extension in agriculture and life sciences.
- [College of Arts & Sciences](https://as.cornell.edu/): Liberal arts and sciences education, departments, and research.
- [Cornell SC Johnson College of Business](https://business.cornell.edu/): Business education spanning undergraduate, MBA, and executive programs.
- [College of Engineering](https://www.engineering.cornell.edu/): Engineering academics, research, and student resources.
- [College of Human Ecology](https://www.human.cornell.edu/): Programs focused on health, design, policy, and human development.
- [School of Industrial and Labor Relations](https://www.ilr.cornell.edu/): Education and research in work, employment, and labor policy.
- [Weill Cornell Medicine](https://weill.cornell.edu/): Medical education, biomedical research, and clinical care.

## Research
- [Research at Cornell](https://research.cornell.edu/): University research enterprise, support services, and strategic initiatives.
- [Explore Cornell Research](https://www.cornell.edu/research/): Research overview, impact areas, and featured discoveries.
- [Office of the Vice President for Research & Innovation](https://research.cornell.edu/about/office-vice-president-research-innovation): Leadership and administration of Cornell research and innovation.
- [Research Services](https://researchservices.cornell.edu/): Compliance, proposal support, and research administration resources.
- [Centers & Institutes](https://research.cornell.edu/centers-institutes): Directory of interdisciplinary research centers and institutes.
- [Cornell Tech](https://tech.cornell.edu/): Graduate technology campus in New York City focused on innovation and entrepreneurship.
- [Global Cornell](https://global.cornell.edu/): International programs, partnerships, and global engagement initiatives.

## Libraries and Scholarly Resources
- [Cornell University Library](https://www.library.cornell.edu/): Library services, collections, research help, and digital resources.
- [Library Hours](https://www.library.cornell.edu/libraries/hours): Current hours for Cornell libraries and study spaces.
- [Research Guides](https://guides.library.cornell.edu/): Subject and course guides for research across disciplines.
- [eCommons](https://ecommons.cornell.edu/): Open-access repository for Cornell scholarship and research outputs.
- [ArXiv](https://arxiv.org/): Open repository for preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, and related fields.
- [Cornell University Press](https://www.cornellpress.cornell.edu/): Scholarly publishing from Cornell’s university press.

## Student Life and Campus Services
- [Student & Campus Life](https://scl.cornell.edu/): Student services, campus life, health, housing, and community support.
- [Housing & Residential Life](https://scl.cornell.edu/residential-life): On-campus housing, residential communities, and living resources.
- [Dining](https://scl.cornell.edu/residential-life/dining): Dining halls, meal plans, menus, and nutrition information.
- [Health](https://health.cornell.edu/): Medical, counseling, and public health services for students.
- [Career Services](https://career.cornell.edu/): Career advising, internships, and job search support.
- [Dean of Students](https://scl.cornell.edu/get-involved/dean-students): Student support, advocacy, and campus engagement resources.
- [Academic Calendar](https://registrar.cornell.edu/academic-calendar): Important academic dates, breaks, and deadlines.

## News and Events
- [Cornell Chronicle](https://news.cornell.edu/): Official university news covering research, campus, and community stories.
- [Events Calendar](https://events.cornell.edu/): University-wide calendar of lectures, performances, and public events.
- [Media Relations](https://news.cornell.edu/media-relations): Press resources, expert contacts, and media support.
- [Cornellians](https://alumni.cornell.edu/cornellians/): Alumni stories, features, and community news.
- [Commencement](https://commencement.cornell.edu/): Graduation ceremony information, schedules, and planning resources.

## Leadership, Values, and Impact
- [Cornell Leadership](https://leadership.cornell.edu/): Information about Cornell’s president, provost, trustees, and senior leadership.
- [Diversity and Inclusion](https://diversity.cornell.edu/): Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging initiatives across Cornell.
- [Indigenous Engagement](https://indigenous.cornell.edu/): Cornell’s work with Indigenous communities, history, and partnerships.
- [Economic Impact](https://economicimpact.cornell.edu/): Data and reports on Cornell’s economic contributions and public value.
- [Sustainability](https://sustainability.cornell.edu/): Climate action, sustainability initiatives, and campus environmental programs.
- [Global Cornell](https://global.cornell.edu/): International strategy, programs, and global partnerships.

## Alumni, Giving, and Athletics
- [Alumni Affairs and Development](https://alumni.cornell.edu/): Alumni engagement, giving, events, and volunteer opportunities.
- [Give to Cornell](https://giving.cornell.edu/): Philanthropic giving options and campaign information.
- [Cornell Alumni](https://alumni.cornell.edu/): Alumni programs, benefits, clubs, and lifelong connections.
- [Cornell Big Red Athletics](https://cornellbigred.com/): Varsity athletics news, schedules, rosters, and tickets.
- [Recreation Services](https://recreation.athletics.cornell.edu/): Fitness, recreation, intramurals, and wellness opportunities.
